title: Behavior variance from expected in status.json in API endpoint.
body:
The endpoint seems to be returning values for bgHigh and bgLow in whatever units xDrip is set to for a preference.  The behavior in nightscout is to always present these as mg units. 

xDrip/app/src/main/java/com/eveningoutpost/dexdrip/webservices/WebServiceStatus.java
